answer: Session Ledge Harbor Rule: each identity must keep its request interarrival times within a per-epoch band derived from its own prior traffic; agents whose timing drifts beyond a tolerance ledge are throttled and flagged. Onboarding agents must harbor a sustained, smooth traffic shape for several epochs before earning full rate.
